rundown: Taipans beat Wildcats 98-90. Taipans led 51-42 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Taipans won it 25-16.
Leading the way — Wildcats: Elijah Pepper 19 pts; Brandon Knight 5 ast; Kristian Doolittle 10 reb. Taipans: Jaylon Brown 31 pts; Jonah Bolden 5 ast; Jack McVeigh 9 reb.
Where Taipans won it: they shot 45% to 43%, shot 40% from three to 26% and had 23 assists to 16.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 20, 3:28 AM ET. It had Wildcats 69% and Taipans 31%, projecting Wildcats 96.3 – Taipans 90.2 (186.5 total, Wildcats by 6.1).

Final: Wildcats 90 – Taipans 98. Wrong winner: it had Wildcats at 69%, and Taipans (31%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Wildcats came in with a league-average attack and a 3% stingier than average defense (7-6, 95.7 scored and 97.8 allowed a game over 13 games), worth about 9 and 9 games of evidence. Projected to score 96.3, they scored 90 (−6.3 points, 7% under); projected to allow 90.2, they allowed 98 (+7.8 points, 9% over).

Taipans came in with a 6% below average attack and a league-average defense (8-6, 92.4 scored and 95.9 allowed a game over 14 games), worth about 8 and 8 games of evidence. Projected to score 90.2, they scored 98 (+7.8 points, 9% over); projected to allow 96.3, they allowed 90 (−6.3 points, 7% under).

The bigger miss was Taipans' scoring (+7.8 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 188 against 186.5 projected (+1.5), about the 54th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±16).

Margin: Taipans by 8 against Wildcats by 6.1 projected, about the 88th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: there were no odds to check the projection against.

The result was off its normal range without being an outlier, so the flags may have played a part.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.021 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +12.9 points. It counts toward Hoops+ scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 84 graded Hoops+ games the algo now scales scoring ×1.014 and gives home teams -1.2 points. Team corrections so far: Wildcats attack ×1.001, defense ×1.012 (4 games); Taipans attack ×1.005, defense ×0.978 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 14.1 points), no bet.
